title: A dhokra mould in section
description: A section through a Bastar dhokra mould: the black soil core, the wax skin wound from strings, and the coats of riverside and termite-hill soil. Place it where the lost-wax mould is described.

u0001.text: Wax strings wrap the soil core, and coats of riverside and termite-hill soil cover the wax.

u0002.text: The core is black field soil kneaded with rice husk; the riverside soil is red.

u0003.text: A dhokra mould in section: soil core, wax skin and two soil coats

C050.text: The core of a figure is shaped from black soil brought from the fields and kneaded with paddy husk, then left to dry in the sun.

quotes.quote: सबसे पहले खेत से लायी गयी काली मिटटी में धान का छिलका मिलाकर गूंथ लिया जाता है । इस प्रकार तैयार की गई मिटटी से मूर्ति का ढांचा या कोर बनाया जाता है ।
A basic model is prepared by using black soil mixed with rice husk in appropriate ratio. Soft pliable dough is made by adding water in it. A basic model of craft is made and dried in the sun.

C061.text: Wax strings are wrapped closely around the hard, green-coated model, and further designs are added in plain wax.

quotes.quote: When wax strings are ready as required, they are wrapped closely around the model, which is hard and dry and green with the application of sem-leaf liquid. When the model is totally covered with wax strings, designs of choice can be made with plain wax too.
7. Wrapping of strings (Tikkal Chadana): Wax strings are tightly wrapped around the dry clay form

C064.text: The waxed model is first coated with sieved riverside soil and powdered wood coal, mixed in proportions of about 85-90% soil to 10-15% coal.

quotes.quote: Powdered sticky riverside soil and powdered wood coal are sieved separately through clean cloth. Mixed in the proportions 90-85% and 10-15%, water is added and kneaded to make dough like consistency and applied over the model.

C066.text: A final layer of powdered termite-hill soil covers the model, with larger wax channels added to form an inverted funnel for pouring the metal.

quotes.quote: Soil from the termite hill is brought, powdered and kneaded to make a smooth mixture.

a bigger channel or channels from wax are added to the earlier channels (for pouring metal) made at the bottom and covered with termite soil mixture to make the passage ready (inverted funnel shape) and dried.

C111.text: The riverside soil, called rui mitti, comes from river beds and is red, very soft and easy to shape, file and finish.

quotes.quote: River side soil (Rui mitti): This soil is procured from the river beds. The soil is very soft and easy to shape, mould, file and hence provide good final shape and finishing. The soil is red in color.
